description.p: Niksnaks-Hosting simplifies the process of creating and managing Minecraft servers on Linux. It removes technical barriers by automating the installation of necessary server files and handling the required Java runtimes for you.

ul.li: Built-in Modrinth browser for easy discovery and mod installation
Integrated Playit support for hosting without manual port forwarding
Graphical interface for viewing performance and editing server properties
Dedicated tools to create and restore server backups
Restoring a Bedrock backup taken on another operating system now installs a server build that runs on this one
A Bedrock server missing its server files says so, and can install them from the properties page
Fixed restoring a Bedrock world backup into the wrong folder
Browse and install CurseForge modpacks from the Files tab, filtered to the server's Minecraft version and loader
Packs install from the author's server build when there is one, so client-only mods are left out
Create a new server from another server's full backup
Import and export Bedrock worlds as .mcworld, and import worlds from a .zip archive
Fixed a crash when importing a world
Choose Java or Bedrock Edition when creating a server
Bedrock servers use Mojang's Dedicated Server build, with their own properties editor
Allow list, worlds, backups and updates all work on Bedrock
Pick a specific Fabric loader or Forge build for the selected Minecraft version
Added offline mode toggle
Fixed world importing bug
Autodelete backups after 30 days
Added java version selection and JVM arguments
Added support for running multiple servers for peak mining and crafting.
Redesigned the Modrinth interface to be more user-friendly.
